defect.mechanism: _load_v2_profiles_from_stubs selects AnalysisArtifact by analysis_run_id only, then keeps latest per scene_id. Journey run 1 left artifacts for scenes 5-9; journey run 2 added 10-15; finalize merged both (11) into run 2 profiles.
defect.secondary: execute_reader_journey_v2 uses load_revision_scenes instead of load_journey_bound_scenes; build_reader_journey_visualization requires len(profiles)==len(scenes) without filtering to included_scene_ids.

fake_vs_real.note: Fake transport only synthesizes model JSON; V2 persist_finalized_v2_profiles is shared.

result_hash_note: No dedicated result_hash column; integrity uses payload/fingerprint fields. E2E will compare SHA256 of GET visualization+profiles digest before/after API restart.
